scope: Packaging metadata only; no application, contract, policy or dependency-version changes

observedFailure.cause: The root lock descriptor retained os:[darwin] but lost upstream dev:true and optional:true and instead recorded extraneous:true

upstreamArtifact.inspection: Downloaded over verified HTTPS, checked against the existing SHA-512 pin, and read JSON members without executing package scripts

repair.futureRegeneration: Run the check after any npm lock regeneration. The tool repairs only this exact known malformed descriptor; missing entries, changed identities, changed optional edges or other metadata require review. Broad regeneration was not used for the release fix.

qualificationLimits.reason: npm's nonoptional platform-check path can inspect the executing host platform rather than the target os/cpu flags. Actual Linux npm ci qualification remains necessary.
qualificationLimits.fullRegressionStatus: Parent runs fresh installation, regression and container qualification separately

officialReferences.relevance: The packages descriptor defines dev/optional flags; an optional dependency of a development dependency carries both flags. OS restrictions remain in the descriptor.
Published npm-shrinkwrap metadata defines the dependency tree at the dependency package.
optionalDependencies declares an optional edge; the published chokidar edge independently agrees with the restored descriptor.
Platform checks distinguish optional and nonoptional nodes; target flags on Darwin are not a substitute for executing npm on Linux.
